scan_linter_check.description:
Flags every g_form.getReference() call in browser scripts. getReference() transfers the whole referenced record to the browser to read what is usually one or two fields; without a callback it is also synchronous (reported by SN-CLIENT-001). Deactivate this check if your standard allows getReference() with a callback.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Avoid using getReference()".
scan_linter_check.name: SN-CLIENT-004: getReference() used in a client script
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Use GlideAjax to return only the fields needed, or g_form.getDisplayValue() for a reference's display value. getReference() transfers the whole referenced record.
scan_linter_check.short_description: g_form.getReference() is used, with or without a callback.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-CLIENT-004: getReference() used in a client script
